items.question: Sum of NNA_IN flows by ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID in FY26-Q1
items.reference_sql: SELECT d0, round(m0, 2) FROM (WITH b0 AS (SELECT 1 AS "k0", "TRAN_FACT_1"."ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID" AS "d0", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(TRAN_FACT_1.TRAN_AM) END AS "value" FROM TRAN_FACT_1 JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 ON TRAN_FACT_1.MNTH_END_DT = MONTH_DIM_1.CLDR_EOM_DT WHERE TRAN_FACT_1.CURR_IN <> 0 AND (TRAN_FACT_1.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND TRAN_FACT_1.RCV_IN = 1) AND MONTH_DIM_1.DW_BRKRG_MNTH_FRM_TODAY_CT <> 0 AND ("TRAN_FACT_1"."DW_TRAN_DT" >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND "TRAN_FACT_1"."DW_TRAN_DT" < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY "TRAN_FACT_1"."ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID"), spine AS (SELECT "k0", "d0" FROM b0), aligned AS (SELECT "s"."k0", "s"."d0", CASE WHEN "b0"."k0" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "b0"."value" END AS "x0", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "b0"."k0" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "b0"."value" END IS NULL THEN 'missing_observation' ELSE NULL END AS "z0" FROM spine AS s LEFT JOIN b0 ON "s"."k0" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "b0"."k0" AND "s"."d0" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "b0"."d0") SELECT "d0" AS "d0", "x0" AS "m0", "z0" AS "m0/reason" FROM aligned ORDER BY "d0") recorded

items.reference_sql: WITH as_is AS (SELECT LAST_DAY(t.MNTH_END_DT) AS reporting_period_month_id, UPPER(strftime(t.MNTH_END_DT, '%b %Y')) AS reporting_period_month, SUM(t.TRAN_AM) AS nna_am FROM TRAN_FACT_1 AS t WHERE t.MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-09-30' AS DATE) AND t.CURR_IN = 1 AND t.RCV_IN = 1 AND t.NNA_IN = 'Y' GROUP BY reporting_period_month_id, reporting_period_month), corporate_frozen AS (SELECT LAST_DAY(t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT) AS reporting_period_month_id, UPPER(strftime(t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT, '%b %Y')) AS reporting_period_month, SUM(t.NNA_AM) AS nna_am FROM F_NNA_FIN AS t WHERE t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY reporting_period_month_id, reporting_period_month), stacked AS (SELECT 'as_is' AS part, 0 AS part_rank, reporting_period_month_id, reporting_period_month, nna_am AS value FROM as_is UNION ALL SELECT 'corporate_frozen' AS part, 1 AS part_rank, reporting_period_month_id, reporting_period_month, nna_am AS value FROM corporate_frozen) SELECT s.reporting_period_month_id AS reporting_period_month_id, arg_min(s.reporting_period_month, s.part_rank) FILTER (WHERE s.reporting_period_month IS NOT NULL) AS reporting_period_month, SUM(IF(s.part = 'as_is', s.value, NULL)) AS nna_am, SUM(IF(s.part = 'corporate_frozen', s.value, NULL)) AS nna_am_comparison, SUM(IF(s.part = 'as_is', s.value, NULL)) - SUM(IF(s.part = 'corporate_frozen', s.value, NULL)) AS nna_am_change, (SUM(IF(s.part = 'as_is', s.value, NULL)) - SUM(IF(s.part = 'corporate_frozen', s.value, NULL))) / NULLIF(ABS(SUM(IF(s.part = 'corporate_frozen', s.value, NULL))), 0) AS nna_am_pct_change FROM stacked AS s GROUP BY reporting_period_month_id ORDER BY reporting_period_month_id

items.reference_sql: SELECT j1.ACCT_RELT_SPS_IN AS sps_account_sps_relationship_id, CASE j1.ACCT_RELT_SPS_IN WHEN 'Y' THEN 'SPS' WHEN 'N' THEN 'Non-SPS' ELSE CAST(j1.ACCT_RELT_SPS_IN AS VARCHAR) END AS sps_account_sps_relationship, SUM(t.NNA_AM) AS nna_am, SUM(t.NNA_AM) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(t.NNA_AM)) OVER (), 0) AS nna_am_share FROM F_NNA_FIN AS t INNER JOIN ACCT_DIM2_1 AS j1 ON t.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID = j1.SRCE_SYS_ID AND t.DW_ACCT_ID = j1.DW_ACCT_ID AND t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j1.DW_EFF_DT AND j1.DW_EXPR_DT INNER JOIN CLIENT_CD_ROLLUP_1 AS j2 ON j1.CLNT_CD = j2.CLNT_CD AND t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j2.DW_EFF_DT AND j2.DW_EXPR_DT WHERE t.DW_TRAN_MNTH_END_DT = CAST('2024-09-30' AS DATE) AND t.CLIENT_DIRECTED_NNA_IN = 'Y' AND j2.SEGMT_LVL_ID5 IN ('S4100') GROUP BY sps_account_sps_relationship_id, sps_account_sps_relationship ORDER BY nna_am DESC

items.reference_sql: SELECT j4.BRCH_CD AS branch_branch_id, j4.BRCH_NM AS branch_branch, SUM(t.TRAN_AM) AS nna_am, SUM(IF(t.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'I', t.TRAN_AM, 0)) AS nna_am_inflows, SUM(IF(t.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'O', t.TRAN_AM, 0)) AS nna_am_outflows FROM TRAN_FACT_EXCL_MFCLR_G AS t INNER JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 AS j1 ON t.MNTH_END_DT = j1.CLDR_EOM_DT INNER JOIN ACCT_DIM2_1 AS j2 ON t.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID = j2.SRCE_SYS_ID AND t.DW_ACCT_ID = j2.DW_ACCT_ID AND t.MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j2.DW_EFF_DT AND j2.DW_EXPR_DT INNER JOIN CLIENT_CD_ROLLUP_1 AS j3 ON j2.CLNT_CD = j3.CLNT_CD AND t.MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j3.DW_EFF_DT AND j3.DW_EXPR_DT INNER JOIN BRCH_DIM_1 AS j4 ON j2.ACCT_DOMCL_BRCH_CD = j4.BRCH_CD AND j4.CURR_IN = 1 WHERE t.MNTH_END_DT = CAST('2024-01-31' AS DATE) AND j1.FIN_MTRC_RLSE_DT BETWEEN t.DW_EFF_DT AND t.DW_EXPR_DT AND t.RCV_IN = 1 AND t.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND j3.SEGMT_LVL_ID5 = 'S4100' AND t.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID IN (100, 200) AND UPPER(j4.BRCH_DIVSN_CD) = 'BR' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(t.DW_TRAN_TYPE_CD, '')) IN ('AQ', 'DT') AND j4.RGN_CD IN ('CEO', 'NER') GROUP BY branch_branch_id, branch_branch ORDER BY nna_am DESC

items.reference_sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT j2.LAST_RCV_HSHLD_DK AS household_household_id, SUM(t.TRAN_AM) AS nna_am FROM TRAN_FACT_EXCL_MFCLR_G AS t INNER JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 AS j1 ON t.MNTH_END_DT = j1.CLDR_EOM_DT INNER JOIN ACCT_DIM2_1 AS j2 ON t.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID = j2.SRCE_SYS_ID AND t.DW_ACCT_ID = j2.DW_ACCT_ID AND t.MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j2.DW_EFF_DT AND j2.DW_EXPR_DT INNER JOIN CLIENT_CD_ROLLUP_1 AS j3 ON j2.CLNT_CD = j3.CLNT_CD AND t.MNTH_END_DT BETWEEN j3.DW_EFF_DT AND j3.DW_EXPR_DT INNER JOIN BRCH_DIM_1 AS j4 ON j2.ACCT_DOMCL_BRCH_CD = j4.BRCH_CD AND j4.CURR_IN = 1 WHERE t.MNTH_END_DT = CAST('2024-01-31' AS DATE) AND j1.FIN_MTRC_RLSE_DT BETWEEN t.DW_EFF_DT AND t.DW_EXPR_DT AND t.RCV_IN = 1 AND t.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND j3.SEGMT_LVL_ID5 = 'S4100' AND t.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID IN (100, 200) AND UPPER(j4.BRCH_DIVSN_CD) = 'BR' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(t.DW_TRAN_TYPE_CD, '')) IN ('AQ', 'DT') AND j4.BRCH_CD IN ('QO') GROUP BY household_household_id), ranked AS (SELECT g.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g.nna_am DESC, g.household_household_id) AS rank_from_top, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g.nna_am ASC, g.household_household_id) AS rank_from_bottom FROM grouped AS g) SELECT r.household_household_id AS household_household_id, r.nna_am AS nna_am, IF(r.rank_from_top <= 10, 'top', 'bottom') AS rank_end, IF(r.rank_from_top <= 10, r.rank_from_top, r.rank_from_bottom) AS rank_position FROM ranked AS r WHERE (r.rank_from_top <= 10 OR r.rank_from_bottom <= 10) ORDER BY nna_am DESC
